summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc., a Toronto-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on NYSE/TSXV, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a November 2, 2026 press release announcing the appointment of Cameron Carter as Vice President, Construction Operations of wholly-owned subsidiary Barkerville Gold Mines Ltd., effective immediately. Carter, with over 18 years of underground mine development experience including 15 years at Dumas Mining, reports to Chairman and CEO Sean Roosen and oversees construction of the Cariboo Gold Project alongside JDS Energy Mining Inc. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed; this is a routine operational management appointment, not an abrupt senior departure, so no special-situation angle applies.
